record_type_quote: Relations among teacher ratings of self-control and adjustment were examined in this study and involved (a) a replication and extension of investigations of Humphrey's Teacher Self-Control Rating Scale (TSCRS) and (b) an analysis of the relation between teacher ratings of self-control and school adjustment across elementary school grades for urban and suburban children.

targets.evidence_quote: Our purpose was to (a) replicate Humphrey's investigation of the TSCRS, (b) extend the TSCRS evaluation to first- through third-grade suburban and first- through fifth-grade urban students, and (c) examine relations between teachers' assessments of self-control and ratings of adjustment.
targets.outcome_quote: Findings include (a) replication and extension of previous TSCRS research findings and (b) consistent, significant patterns of relations between self-control and adjustment across elementary grades.
targets.outcome_reasoning: Explicit summary verdict that previous TSCRS findings replicated.
